articles.title: Kingfisher slips despite guidance upgrade after solid third quarter
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Kingfisher lifted its full-year profit guidance on Tuesday after third-quarter like-for-like sales rose 0.8%, driven by strong growth at Screwfix and in Poland and Iberia. The B&Q and Castorama owner now expects adjusted pretax profit of £610 million to £640 million, up from £595 million to £635 million.
